name: Vampire - Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only) - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a attack

results.text: Your unholy grip ensnares your foe like a vice, their bones groaning under your supernatural strength!
With a snarl, you crush flesh and splinter bone beneath your relentless assault.
The creature shudders as your fangs sink in, their blood turning to ice in your veins.
Your strike lands with the force of a tombstone dropping, sending them crashing into the dirt!
A flash of crimson and agony erupts as your fist connects like a hammer from the grave!
